ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70% high-intensity (white/light-grey) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zones occupying the central 80% of both fluke lobes, bounded by a continuous low-intensity black margin at the trailing edge and distal tips; multiple low-intensity linear segments intersect the high-intensity fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Centrally located V-shaped depression with an approximate 85-degree interior angle relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left trailing edge exhibits high-frequency micro-serrations; right trailing edge exhibits irregular, high-amplitude macro-serrations and significant jagged indentations/geometric cutouts.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, roughly circular low-intensity clusters localized near the median notch vertex and the proximal lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions on both lobes; right lobe shows three prominent long diagonal parallel marks; left lobe shows a cluster of shorter, radiating linear marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation on the right lobe trailing edge forming a non-standard geometric profile; extensive linear 'rake mark' scarring across the interior ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific multi-vector rake mark pattern providing unique spatial identifier across both lobes.
